acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for senior home safety modifications in the Bay Area, look for one with experience in accessible home renovations and a strong understanding of senior living needs. Verify their licensing and insurance for your peace of mind. Check their portfolio for similar projects and ask for references. A good contractor should provide clear communication, a detailed proposal, and be transparent about timelines and costs. Prioritize those who can demonstrate expertise in creating safe, functional, and comfortable environments for older adults, like City Dweller, LLC, which serves the Bay Area.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience in accessible renovations, proper licensing, and good references. Prioritize clear communication and expertise in senior safety modifications.
